        if target in line or digest in line or re.search(r"\.rs|src/|rglob|glob\(|SOURCE_FILES|CURRENT_FILES|INTEGRATION_SHA256|APPROVED_.*DIGEST",line):

print("EXACT TARGET-DIGEST REFERENCES (all tracked text):")
for name in files:
    p=Path(name)
    if not name or not p.is_file(): continue
    raw=p.read_bytes()
    if b"\0" in raw: continue
    text=raw.decode(errors="replace")
    for n,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
        if digest in line: print(f"{name}:{n}:{line}")
